thesis: 금융여건은 성장주에 우호적이지 않다. 연준은 9월 16일 25bp 인상해 3.75~4.00%로 올렸고, SEP의 2026·2027년 말 정책금리 중앙값은 모두 4.1%다. 2026 PCE 전망은 3.7%, core PCE 3.4%로 높다. 10년 TIPS 실질금리는 9월 17일 2.61%, Brent는 9월 15일 $130.80까지 상승했다. 반면 미 하이일드 OAS는 270bp로 좁아 신용경색은 아니다. 따라서 종목 점수는 건드리지 않고 신규 위험예산/매수 속도만 0.7배로 감속한다.

evidence.claim: FOMC raised the federal-funds target range by 25bp to 3.75%–4.00% on 2026-09-16; vote was 12-0.
September SEP median appropriate federal-funds rate is 4.1% for both end-2026 and end-2027; median 2026 PCE/core PCE inflation projections are 3.7%/3.4%.
ICE BofA US High Yield OAS was 2.70% (270bp) on 2026-09-17, indicating credit spreads remained tight rather than stressed.
EIA Brent spot price reached $130.80/bbl on 2026-09-15, up sharply from late-August levels around $90/bbl.

counterevidence: HY OAS near 270bp shows corporate credit markets are still functioning and not pricing broad funding stress.
The Fed's SEP still projects solid 2.3% real GDP growth in 2026 and 2.4% in 2027, not recession.
A single 25bp hike does not by itself establish a prolonged tightening cycle; future policy remains data-dependent.
unknowns: How persistent the September energy-price shock will be and how much it passes through to core inflation.
Whether policy remains near 4.1% through 2027 or reverses as energy/base effects fade.
Whether tight credit spreads reprice abruptly if real yields remain elevated.
falsifiers: A sustained reversal in oil plus clear disinflation and a Fed pivot would justify restoring the pacing multiplier toward 1.0.
HY OAS above 400bp or a material issuance-market freeze would justify lowering the multiplier below 0.7.
A material fall in 10-year real yields without weakening growth would reduce duration pressure.
next_checks: Next FOMC statement and SEP/path communication.
Brent/WTI normalization versus core inflation pass-through.
